prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is approached, take it and process it. If visible, approach it. If in reach, grab it. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectInReach    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO ProcessObject
	END
